name: Shadow Chimps
summary:
Shadow Chimps is an exciting and terrifying horror game that combines gorilla-style movement with creepy environments and endless fun with friends. In this game, you’ll step into the fur of a chimp trying to survive the darkness that lurks in the abandoned forests, haunted caves, and eerie jungles that make up the game’s unique maps.

Run, climb, swing, and parkour your way through shadowy levels where you never know what might be watching you from the trees. Use your agility to escape terrifying creatures
